attempted_claim: Let (X,ω) be a compact monotone symplectic manifold, and let F(X)_{λ,Q} be a toroidal subcategory, meaning a Fukaya-category summand split-generated by a monotone Lagrangian torus equipped with a rank-one local system at an isolated critical point of its superpotential. If T1 and T2 are any two toroidal generators of F(X)_{λ,Q}, must T1 and T2 be quasi-isomorphic as Z/2-graded A∞-objects, up to a shift?
decisive_failure: The investigation was limited to formal Morita/Clifford arguments, closed-open and Jacobian invariants, and literature-level checks of standard Fano examples; it could not verify exotic-torus split-generation or mirror-chart identifications needed for a geometric counterexample, nor supply the new rigidity theorems a positive answer would require.
